title: Disaster Averted
cn: 第 9 集 · 灾难已过
novel: The gang [[reminisced|reminisce]] about Hurricane Irene and how it had [[affected|affect]] their lives. During the hurricane, they had all been [[trapped|trap]] together in Ted's apartment. They [[shared|share]] stories about the [[chaotic|chaotic]] night and laughed about their [[fears|fear]]. Ted had tried to be [[brave|brave]] but was secretly [[terrified|terrify]] of the storm. Marshall had tried to keep everyone calm by telling jokes. Lily had worried about their apartment [[flooding|flood]]. Robin had reported on the storm for the news and kept everyone [[informed|inform]]. Barney had been upset because his [[suits|suit]] got wet in the rain. Meanwhile, Barney tried to [[get out of|get out of]] wearing the ducky tie. He [[desperately|desperate]] wanted to remove it and wear normal clothes again. He tried to [[convince|convince]] Marshall and Lily to end the bet early. He offered them gifts and favors, but they [[refused|refuse]]. They said a bet was a bet and he had to keep his [[promise|promise]]. Barney was [[frustrated|frustrate]] and tried every [[trick|trick]] he could think of. He even tried to [[bribe|bribe]] them with expensive dinners. Marshall and Lily [[enjoyed|enjoy]] watching Barney squirm. They said the tie stayed until the bet was complete. The gang agreed that despite the [[chaos|chaos]] of the hurricane, it had brought them closer together. Sometimes [[disasters|disaster]] can create the best memories.

trick.en: a clever way to achieve something

bribe.en: to give gifts to influence someone
